selected_window_findings.finding: State-selected bridge. One branch directly loads DAT_0167eae4 and returns its +0x204 relationship manager through 0x00c4f030; other branches return SpacePlayerData+0x0c or zero. It is neither a manager getter nor a slot initializer.

One-argument receiver method. It returns null for ID -1, searches receiver+0x150 through 0x00e5c780, compares the result pointer with receiver+0x154, and returns node payload +0x14 when non-end. It performs no mutation and does not contain an exact-key equality check.

Reads SpacePlayerData+0x18 as the current empire ID and +0x1c as a borrowed cEmpire cache. On a cache miss or ID mismatch it calls 0x00b3d2a0, then 0x00ba9370, AddRefs the new result, replaces +0x1c, and Releases the old cache. It mutates the empire cache, not any of the four global manager slots.

Four adjacent six-byte loaders. The two earlier slots are alternate high-fan-in manager accessors; the two SDK-named later slots are canonical noun and star getters. No body validates, refreshes, AddRefs, or writes its slot.

Uses DAT_0167eae4 with 0x00ba9370 and 0x01021300 for empire identity, DAT_0167eae0 with noun/player helpers, and DAT_0167eb60 through canonical cGameNounManager::Get. It crosses all three contracts but does not compare the noun pointer slots.

Contains the decisive direct noun-manager chain 0x00b3d300 -> ECX -> 0x00b21340. It also calls 0x00b25f40, 0x00b25fb0, 0x00b25c30, 0x00b1fdb0, and 0x00f67d90 on the same alternate noun-manager contract.

Contains the complementary pair 0x00b3d2a0 -> 0x00ba9370 for star/empire identity and 0x00b3d300 -> 0x00b25ca0 / 0x00b21340 for noun data. This proves the alternate slots are separate manager domains even when co-used.

SDK-named SpaceTeleportTo uses DAT_0167eae0 through 0x00f67d90 to obtain cGameNounManager::mpPlayer and separately uses DAT_0167eae4 through 0x00bb59b0. The two returns are not compared or substituted.

Unowned 14-byte static thunk: call 0x00b3d3a0; load [EAX]; tail-dispatch [vtable+0x28]. It supplies missing executable evidence for the canonical cStarManager slot but does not write or initialize that slot.
